name: Signal E2E Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, feature/**]
    paths:
      - 'service/**'
      - 'clients/**'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'bun.lock'
      - '.github/workflows/signal-e2e-tests.yml'
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'service/**'
      - 'clients/**'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'bun.lock'

jobs:
  e2e-tests:
    name: Run Signal E2E Tests
    uses: metorial/.github/.github/workflows/reusable-e2e-tests.yml@main
    with:
      service_directory: service
      compose_project_prefix: signal-ci
      compose_profiles: 'infra service'
      wait_services: |
        signal-postgres
        signal-redis
        signal-object-storage
        signal-service
      test_container: signal-service
      test_command: cd /app/service && bun run test -- --mode ci --reporter verbose

name: Build and Publish

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

env:
  REGISTRY: ghcr.io
  IMAGE_NAME: metorial/signal

jobs:
  build-and-publish-docker:
    name: Build and Publish Docker Image
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up QEMU
        uses: docker/setup-qemu-action@v3

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Log in to Container Registry
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ${{ env.REGISTRY }}
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Extract metadata for Docker
        id: meta
        uses: docker/metadata-action@v5
        with:
          images: ${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}
          tags: |
            type=ref,event=branch
            type=ref,event=pr
            type=sha
            type=raw,value=latest,enable={{is_default_branch}}

      - name: Build and push Docker image
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          context: ./service
          file: ./service/Dockerfile
          platforms: linux/amd64,linux/arm64
          push: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' }}
          tags: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tags }}
          labels: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.labels }}
          build-args: |
            SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN=${{ secrets.SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN }}

name: Check Legal Boilerplate

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, edited, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  legal:
    permissions:
      pull-requests: write
      contents: read
    uses: metorial/.github/.github/workflows/legal-boilerplate.yml@main

services:
  postgres:
    profiles: ['infra']
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: signal-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: signal
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: signal
      POSTGRES_DB: signal
    volumes:
      - postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
      - ./init-test-db.sh:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/init-test-db.sh
    ports:
      - '25432:5432'
    networks:
      - signal-network
    healthcheck:
      test: ['CMD-SHELL', 'pg_isready -U signal']
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10

  redis:
    profiles: ['infra']
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: signal-redis
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - '26379:6379'
    networks:
      - signal-network
    healthcheck:
      test: ['CMD', 'redis-cli', 'ping']
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10

  object-storage:
    profiles: ['infra']
    image: ghcr.io/metorial/object-storage:latest
    container_name: signal-object-storage
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - object-store-data:/app/data
    environment:
      RUST_LOG: info
      OBJECT_STORE__SERVER__HOST: 0.0.0.0
      OBJECT_STORE__SERVER__PORT: 52010
      OBJECT_STORE__BACKEND__TYPE: ${OBJECT_STORAGE_BACKEND_TYPE:-local}
      OBJECT_STORE__BACKEND__ROOT_PATH: ${OBJECT_STORAGE_BACKEND_ROOT_PATH:-/app/data}
      OBJECT_STORE__BACKEND__REGION: ${OBJECT_STORAGE_AWS_REGION:-us-east-1}
      OBJECT_STORE__BACKEND__PHYSICAL_BUCKET: ${OBJECT_STORAGE_AWS_S3_BUCKET:-signal-local}
      AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID: ${OBJECT_STORAGE_AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID:-test}
      AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: ${OBJECT_STORAGE_AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY:-test}
      AWS_REGION: ${OBJECT_STORAGE_AWS_REGION:-us-east-1}
    ports:
      - '25010:52010'
    networks:
      - signal-network
    healthcheck:
      test: ['CMD-SHELL', 'curl -f http://localhost:52010/health || exit 1']
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10

  signal:
    profiles: ['service']
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: dev.Dockerfile
    container_name: signal-service
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - '25050:52050'
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: ${DATABASE_URL}
      REDIS_URL: ${REDIS_URL}
      OBJECT_STORAGE_URL: ${OBJECT_STORAGE_URL}
      LOGS_BUCKET_NAME: ${LOGS_BUCKET_NAME}
    volumes:
      - ./src:/app/service/src:ro
      - ./package.json:/app/service/package.json:ro
      - ./tsconfig.json:/app/service/tsconfig.json:ro
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
      object-storage:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test:
        [
          'CMD-SHELL',
          "bun -e \"fetch('http://localhost:52050/').then(()=>process.exit(0)).catch(()=>process.exit(1))\""
        ]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10
    networks:
      - signal-network

volumes:
  postgres_data:
    driver: local
  object-store-data:
    driver: local

networks:
  signal-network:
    driver: bridge

{
  "name": "signal-service",
  "module": "index.ts",
  "type": "commonjs",
  "private": true,
  "scripts": {
    "start": "bun run server:start",
    "dev": "bun --watch ./src/server.ts",
    "server:build": "ncc build ./src/server.ts -o ./dist --source-map && bun run sentry:sourcemaps",
    "sentry:sourcemaps": "sentry-cli sourcemaps inject --org metorial --project mte-signal ./dist && sentry-cli sourcemaps upload --org metorial --project mte-signal ./dist",

    "infra:up": "docker compose -p signal -f ./docker-compose.dev.yml --profile infra up -d --pull always",

#!/bin/sh
set -e

# Create databases for CI/local-compose services if they don't exist
dbs="signal-test"
for db in $dbs; do
  exists=$(psql --username "$POSTGRES_USER" --dbname "$POSTGRES_DB" \
    -tAc "SELECT 1 FROM pg_database WHERE datname='${db}'")
  if [ "$exists" != "1" ]; then
    psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --username "$POSTGRES_USER" --dbname "$POSTGRES_DB" \
      -c "CREATE DATABASE \"${db}\";"
  fi
done

echo "Database initialization complete"
